Variants.Content: Kipunada balances landholders, traders and religious communities. Patronage draws support, while levies can drive groups to another protector.

Kipunada balances landholders, traders and religious communities. Followers retain family ties; decisions about guards and distant service affect common participation. Protection and levies affect the choice of local patron.
